model_ownership.gate: Original BoardFftSpeechGate in existing sole child
model_ownership.pool: Single original BoardFrontendPool in child arbitrates auto and gate-RPC barge
model_ownership.normal_capture: Original BoardAutomaticCapture / SpeechEndpoint / BoundedPcmCaptureMixin / 8-frame queue in child
model_ownership.parent: RemoteAutomaticCapture metadata poll plus once-only completed original PCM TAKE
model_ownership.barge: Original parent capture/echo/verification/ACK; same child gate via existing fixed-frame RPC

protocol.transport: Existing anonymous socketpair, no network listener/audio file
protocol.take_limit: Only AUTO_TAKE response permits 640000B PCM +4096B metadata+4B length
protocol.metadata: Strict fixed status/clip schema, fixed error codes, scalar metric white list
protocol.callback: Owner start-thread snapshot/take only; current CID/recording/monitor guard
protocol.ready: Original Mcp READY plus reader/source/owner released; parent onset callback before READY
protocol.invalidation: Start/cancel/close/take local revision barriers reject late polls and completed results
protocol.pcm: Original CapturedAudio/AudioRef metadata + exact bytes + SHA, no parent waveform transform

cleanup.normal: Remote cancel/close waits original child capture cleanup, keeps worker for reuse
cleanup.shutdown: Original pool close then owned worker STOP; 6s grace for original bounded capture cleanup, no worker SIGKILL
cleanup.start_failure: Explicit original source/endpoint/mic lock retirement after partial original start failure
cleanup.ipc_failure: Lost start ACK or cancel/close IPC failure retires exact owned worker, no guessing a new capture
cleanup.abrupt_worker_exit: Original arecord argv execs under guarded Python shim: parent PID before/after Linux prctl PDEATHSIG SIGTERM
cleanup.retired_owner: Two bounded metadata-only tombstones allow old automatic close without affecting active barge
